about_the_game:
They say there was a fisherman, burdened by memories too heavy to carry, who sailed into waters where no man had ever dared to go. Some would tell you he sought redemption, others would say it was peace he was after. But the sea gives neither.

Unravel the Horrors of the Sea

As the days turned into nights, and the nights into days, the fisherman sailed farther, farther than any man should. His boat became a part of him, and the waters around him grew dark and deep, as though the sea itself had swallowed his mind. Soon, no one could tell where the sea ended and his madness began.

The whispers still call to those brave enough to listen, and the tide never forgets.

A Unique Fishing Experience

An increasingly more challenging mechanic that rewards your skill and evolves as you progress.

Each fish behaves differently and requires you to adapt your approach.

No Fish Like the Other

Uncover horrifying creatures with each catch you pull out of the sea.

Game features

  • Atmosphere & PSX-style Graphics - Immerse yourself in a hauntingly nostalgic world with PSX-inspired visuals that enhance the eerie atmosphere of the game.

  • Fishing Mechanics - Cast your line into the dark waters, where the sea tests your coordination while pulling you deeper into madness.

  • Dark, Gripping Linear Story - Unravel a tragic tale of guilt, loss, and redemption, where the past is never far behind and the sea holds secrets that may never let you go.

  • An Entirely New Experience of Mourning Tide - Featuring 1 hour of gameplay.

content_descriptors.notes: Mourning Tide contains mature themes, including psychological trauma, emotional abuse, gore, violence, and depictions of grief and self-destructive behavior. The story explores a fisherman’s internal struggles, including moments of despair and a loss of identity. The game features intense emotional situations, references to suicide, murder and scenes that may be disturbing to sensitive players. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman sails into forbidden waters. With every catch, the echoes of his life rise to the surface. Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide.
